answer.evidence: Two bodies stand side by side: a red postbox on the left (x about 5-16) and a vending machine on the right (x about 17-31). The vending machine has a light band at rows 3-6 (L about 224-230). Its last row, 6, is slightly darker (L=200) at x=23, and below it come the blue display and the grey front face, which runs from about row 7 to row 29. There is no distinct eave shadow, so the top evidence is weak and may be a cornice. The postbox top is a lighter orange gradient at rows 5-9, where the silhouette widens from 25 to 29 to 31 px. This suggests a rounded, tilted top surface. Both parts have a front face of 20+ rows, so the object is a weak three-quarter view with a shallow top band of about 3 rows.

answer.evidence: The scene is two objects side by side: a red postbox on the left (x about 5-16) and a vending machine on the right (x about 17-31). The vending machine is the largest volume. Its top, rows 3-6 (light #dce1e8), is a face-on frame strip with a dark outline above it. It has no front-edge line and no eave shadow, and the blue display window starts directly below at row 7. The rest of the machine is a vertical face: display, buttons, grille and dispensing slot. So the machine reads as a front elevation with at most a 1-2 row rim. The postbox lid, rows 5-9, widens from 25 to 31 pixels and has a lighter orange top. That gives a weak sloped or ellipse-like top, but it is small and does not carry the whole structure. The postbox body below it is a plain vertical face with slots. The main body therefore lacks a clear horizontal top surface.
